title: Spiral Matrix
constraints: All rows have the same length, at most 10.
inputFormat: Implement spiralOrder(matrix). Inputs below show JavaScript function arguments; there is no stdin parsing.
outputFormat: Return an array containing each cell value exactly once in clockwise spiral order, starting at the top-left. A matrix with no cells returns [].
